tools.name: halaxy_find_available_appointments
tools.description: Find free appointment times between start and end for a given duration, respecting each practitioner's online booking preferences (buffer time, lead time, advance booking limit). Narrow it with practitioner, practitioner_role or organization. GET /main/Appointment/$find.

tools.name: halaxy_create_patient
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Creates a new patient record (always a new one: search with halaxy_list_patients first to avoid a duplicate). Pass managing_organization (the practice group id, e.g. PG-12345, from halaxy_list_organizations) if Halaxy asks for it. POST /main/Patient.

tools.name: halaxy_create_appointment
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Books an appointment for a patient with a practitioner at a clinic (the practitioner role). Halaxy also creates the invoice, clinical note and reminder. Use halaxy_find_available_appointments for free times. By default a double booking is refused (HTTP 409, nothing

tools.name: halaxy_update_appointment_status
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Sets the patient's status on an appointment (shown in the Halaxy calendar), for example arrived, attended, confirmed or cancelled. "cancelled (no charge)" also sets the invoice to $0. For a group appointment pass patient_id to say whose status changes. PATCH /main/

tools.name: halaxy_create_clinical_note
tools.description: Writes to the live Halaxy account. Adds a clinical note to a patient's record as a DRAFT (preliminary); the practitioner reviews and publishes it in Halaxy. The author is a PractitionerRole (practitioner at a clinic). Only HTML text is supported. POST /main/DocumentReference.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "halaxy_list_fees" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: halaxy_list_practitioners, halaxy_create_patient · Private data: halaxy_list_patients, halaxy_get_patient, halaxy_get_coverage, halaxy_create_patient, halaxy_create_clinical_note · Public sink: halaxy_create_patient, halaxy_create_appointment, halaxy_create_clinical_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: halaxy_list_practitioners, halaxy_create_patient · Private data: halaxy_list_patients, halaxy_get_patient, halaxy_get_coverage, halaxy_create_patient, halaxy_create_clinical_note · Public sink: halaxy_create_patient, halaxy_create_appointment, halaxy_create_clinical_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
